segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Hello?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, hello. I wanted to enquire about hiring a room in the Village Hall, for the evening of September the first.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Let me just see ... Yes, we have both rooms available that evening. There’s our Main Hall – that’s got seating for 200 people. Or there’s the Charlton Room ...

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Sorry?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: The Charlton [[ ]] Room – C-H-A-R-L-T-O-N. That’s got seating for up to one hundred.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, we’re organising a dinner to raise money for a charity, and we’re hoping for at least 150 people, so I think we’ll go for the Main Hall. How much would that cost?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Let’s see. You wanted it for the evening of September 1st?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, that’s a Saturday.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: So from six pm to midnight that’d be £115 [[ ]] – that’s the weekend price, it’s £75 on weekdays.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That’s all right.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: And I have to tell you there’s also a deposit of £250, which is returnable of course as long as there’s no damage. But we do insist that this is paid in cash [[ ]] , we don’t take cards for that. You can pay the actual rent of the room however you like though – cash, credit card, cheque ...

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, well I suppose that’s OK. So does the charge include use of tables and chairs and so on?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Oh, yes.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And what about parking? [[ ]]

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Yeah, that’s all included. The only thing that isn’t included is ... you said you were organising a dinner?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yeah.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Well, you’ll have to pay extra for the kitchen if you want to use that. It’s £25. It’s got very good facilities – good quality cookers and fridges and so on.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK, well I suppose that’s all right. We can cover the cost in our entry charges.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Right. So I’ll make a note of that. Now there are just one or two things you need to think about before the event. For example, you’ll have to see about getting a licence if you’re planning to have any music during the meal. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh, really?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: It’s quite straightforward, I’ll give you the details later on. And about a week or ten days before your event you’ll need to contact the caretaker, that’s Mr Evans, to make the arrangements for entry [[ ]] – he’ll sort that out with you.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And do I give him the payment as well?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: No, you do that directly with me. ——————

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. Now is there anything I need to know about what happens during the event?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Well, as you’ll be aware, of course the building is no smoking throughout.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Of course.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Now, are you having a band?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Well, they’ll have a lot of equipment, so rather than using the front door they should park their van round the back and use the stage door there [[ ]] . You can open that from inside but don’t forget to lock it at the end.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: And talking of bands, I’m sure I don’t need to tell you this, but you must make sure that no one fiddles about with the black box by the fire door – that’s a system that cuts in when the volume reaches a certain level. It’s a legal requirement.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Sure. Anyway, we want people to be able to talk to one another so we don’t want anything too loud. Oh, that reminds me, we’ll be having speeches – are there any microphones available?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Yeah. Just let the caretaker know, he’ll get those for you. Right, now when the event is over we do ask that the premises are left in good condition. So there’s a locked cupboard and you’ll be informed of the code you need to open that [[ ]] . It’s got all the cleaning equipment, brushes and detergent and so on.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right. So what do we need to do after everyone’s gone? Sweep the floors I suppose?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Well, actually they have to be washed, not just swept [[ ]] . Then you’ll be provided with black plastic bags, so all the rubbish must be collected up and left outside the door.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Of course. We’ll make sure everything’s left tidy. Oh, and I forgot to ask, I presume we can have decorations in the room?

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: Yes, but you must take them down afterwards. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Sure.

segments.speaker: OFFICIAL
segments.en: And the chairs and tables should be stacked up neatly at the back of the room.
